text:
emma: Quick alignment: we need a tight MVP for Optimize advice (batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). Goal: ship a lightweight advisor + docs for pilots.

raj: Agreed. Proposal: prioritize batching advisor API, then caching patterns, then quant recs, finally eval alerts. Keep everything toggleable. :+1:

sofia: From field notes: AcmeHealth wants private deploy checklist; EduAI wants batch-embedding cost guidance. I'll draft two short vignettes.

liam: Runtime guard rails: per-request token cap, max batch concurrency, and explicit fallback to unquantized model when eval fails. Will prototype a test harness.

ana: Pilot acceptance: one hosted + one private pilot must run advice and confirm no quality regressions for 2 weeks. Docs: console example + API snippet + one-pager.

raj: API sketch idea: POST /v1/optimize/advice -> small payload with route metrics; response includes batching, cache, quant fields and a one-line rationale. Keep JSON tiny for Console/CLI use.

sofia: example vignette: "bulk-embeddings" -> expected token-cost drop 25% with q4_0 + cache recommendations. Will include eval prompts and expected delta thresholds.

emma: Launch criteria (MVP): 2 pilots signed + eval alert wired to at least one eval suite (concordance drop >=5%). Fallbacks required for quant/cache.

liam: Note: be explicit about safe defaults: batching=off, cache=read-through disabled, quant=off unless "safe-fallback" set. That avoids accidental regressions.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advice v0.1 -> staging 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.

emma: Next steps: Raj draft API spec by Tue; Sofia write vignettes; Liam runtime guards; Ana coordinate pilots. Sync Wed 10am PT. Post blockers here.

raj: I'll start a tiny OpenAPI snippet and a test vector list.
